title: With the riches taken from Qashtāla, the Emperor Ismāʿīl orders a madrasa built in every town and city of the empire, not only in the lands the crown holds directly but in the ṭāʾifas too

data.funding: the wealth taken from Castile in the War of Jillīqiya (the treasury stood at 816 after the Peace of Rajab)
data.scope: every town and city, the ṭāʾifas included (Trent's account, read as 'not just the ones held directly by the crown')
